author: Kybear
quote: If you've played any of the older Grand theft auto or Red dead redemption games then you'll understand how garbage, woke and gay this game is. They just made a tremendously bad chore simulator and slapped the "Grand theft auto 6" title on it to hype up the game, this is NOT a Grand theft auto game. Rock star needs to stop hiring fat, gay and trans women and maybe they'll actually make a good game in the future.
